findings.text: The company's status is recorded as active, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next accounts due 30 September 2027 and the last accounts made up to 31 December 2025.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next statement due 20 July 2027 and the last one made up to 6 July 2026.
The register shows 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 142 (appointed 1 March 2017) and PERSON 143 (appointed 16 December 2024), and 1 other officer.
One current person with significant control is recorded, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 726, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
Seven charges are registered: 1 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 6 satisfied.
Across the 2 current directors checked, 62 other companies were found, of which 1 is in liquidation, so the directors are linked to a company in an insolvency process.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: PB LTD (00656314) is an active company incorporated on 13 April 1960, with no insolvency record held, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and one outstanding secured charge.
